summary: Oracle JDK/JRE 8u211 (16 April 2019) and later are under the OTN licence, which is free only for personal use, development, testing, prototyping and demonstration - commercial or production use needs a Java SE Universal Subscription.

Oracle JDK/JRE 8u202 and earlier are under the old Binary Code Licence, which allows free internal use on general purpose desktops and servers but excludes the Commercial Features and excludes embedded or dedicated-function systems - review how this installation is used.

Oracle JDK 17 releases up to and including 17.0.12 (September 2024) are under the No-Fee Terms and Conditions licence and are free for all uses including production, but this line receives no further free updates - 17.0.13 and later are OTN licensed.
JVMAudit does not recognise the vendor string 'Acme Java Systems Ltd.', so it will not guess at the licence.
remediation: Check the LICENSE file inside /opt/java/mystery-jdk, and please open an issue at https://github.com/VeliAliyev/jvmaudit with the contents of its release file so this vendor can be recognised.
